scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run build:shell && npm run build:demo
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix open-mova-core run typecheck && npm --prefix open-mova-shell run typecheck && npm --prefix open-mova-mf-template run typecheck && npm --prefix open-mova-cli run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix open-mova-core run test:unit && npm --prefix open-mova-cli run test:unit
scripts.pack:check: npm run build:core && npm run build:cli && npm run pack:verify
scripts.lint: node tooling/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --config tooling/eslint.config.mjs open-mova-core/src open-mova-core/test open-mova-cli/src open-mova-cli/test open-mova-shell/src open-mova-mf-template/src scripts tooling
